note: Official Pokemon Scarlet/Violet 2D art (static PNG, RGBA, anti-aliased edges, transparent background), stored in PokeAPI under scarlet-violet/icons although these are full-size images, not menu icons. Chosen because Gen 7+ games are 3D: PokeAPI's in-game battle sets for them are animated (ultra-sun-ultra-moon GIF, sword-shield / scarlet-violet 512x512 animated WebP), the static PNG icons are tiny (gen-vii 40x30, sword-shield 68x68), and the 96x96 pixel sprites under generation-v/black-white and the default sprites/pokemon/{id}.png are fan-made (Smogon) above #650, not original game art. Canvas size varies per file (width 79-241 px, height 87-198 px in this folder) and is cropped tight to the Pokemon (bounding box = full canvas, no padding); scale by the longer side.
